name: Yuzuriha Retreat
description: Yuzuriha Retreat is an editorial theme for residential retreat lodges, yoga and walking retreats and small hospitality businesses. A full-bleed first-light photograph sits under a frosted header with a day-line along its foot, followed by square calendar cards, a hairline retreat day, offset lodge photographs, a price table and a ridgeline-cut closing band. Built with block patterns, theme.json tokens and full site editing support.
